title: Dan Sherman taken to an NSA complex for sine-wave training

tellings.quote: he got taken to this NSA complex and he was given these headphones

plain: In the 1990s, a man named Dan Sherman says he was taken to a complex of the National Security Agency, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, in Maryland, possibly at Fort Meade, and given headphones for training with sine-wave tones. Michels relays this from Sherman's own account in the book Above Black. If true, it would mean a secret government programme was training people to pick up signals of some unusual kind.
